verdict.rationale: Decorating functions with `weave.op` produces a nested trace tree of inputs and outputs. Threads group traces belonging to a single session or conversation. Weave also treats sessions, turns, steps, tools and sub-agents as first-class concepts, and accepts OTel spans that link to calls in both directions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that nested agent spans and thread or session grouping work as documented in real multi-agent runs.
